correctness.rationale: For every m,r>=1 the four specified positive pair-count jump rates make a finite irreducible reflection-symmetric Markov chain. The generator gives LX=mY-rX and LY=-rX-mY and three stationary quadratic moment equations; independently derived and solved to obtain Var(A/m)=(m+3r)/(4(2mr+m+r)), Cov(A/m,B/r)=(r-m)/(4(2mr+m+r)), Var(B/r)=(3m+r)/(4(2mr+m+r)). For fixed r, scale A/m: fast conditional B chain has unique Binomial(r,1-x) equilibrium including absorbing endpoints; the slow marginal stationary generator r(1-2x)∂+x(1-x)∂² yields Hausdorff moments (r)_k/(2r)_k and hence Beta(r,r). Bounded generators and compactness justify the weak joint limit; finite checks only corroborate.
